title: Session file
description: One persisted session (C5): the transcript and plan that survive across runs and can be resumed by id. One JSONL file per session under the session directory (default ~/.config/sudoer/sessions): the first line is this header object (type "header"), every following line is one transcript entry shaped as message.schema.json#/$defs/entry.

type.description: Marks the first JSONL line as the header.

id.description: Session identity used to resume (C5): the YYMMDD-HHmmSS stamp, plus _<keywords> once an LLM summary named it; a pinned id (--session) is used verbatim.

stamp.description: The timestamp part of the id (YYMMDD-HHmmSS, local time), or a pinned caller-chosen id.

keywords.description: The at-most-five keyword slug the model summarized from the session's first goal; part of the file name when present.

pinned.description: True when the caller pinned the id: the id never gains keywords.

baseline.description: Opaque handle to the workspace baseline captured at session open, backing diff/restore (C3).

plan.description: The agent's plan (C1): a small ordered task list.

planItem.description: One plan item: a short task and whether it is done.
